english_policy.waiver_notes: International students must show the required English level for the course; Computer Science, Economics and Mechanical Engineering all fall under Profile B1. English-language qualifications such as A/AS-Level English Language (grade D), GCSE English Language (grade C/4) or IGCSE English as a First Language (grade C) are also accepted (see the Profile B1 page).

english.notes: Profile B1 (the profile for Computer Science, Economics and Mechanical Engineering). IELTS Academic; 6.5 overall and no less than 5.5 in any section.
Profile B1. Old 0-120 scale, tests taken before 21 Jan 2026.
Profile B1. New 1-6 scale, tests taken from 21 Jan 2026: 4.5 overall and no less than 3.5 in any section.
Profile B1. PTE Academic; 67 with no less than 59 in all communicative skills.
Profile B1. Test taken from 1 July 2024; 120 overall and no less than 95 in any Integrated Subscore.
Profile B1. Cambridge English Advanced or Proficiency: 176 overall, no less than 162 in any element (accepted for up to 7 years before the programme starts).

tier_notes.general: Complete University Guide 2027 overall ranking: 11th of 130 UK universities (A = ranks 6-15 on the national scale).
